name.zh: 勇者之塔 第62层 宾尼纳拉、巨镰鸟、艾丝柏

location.zh: 精灵太空站 资源区 勇者之塔

reward_note: No per-floor reward is recorded for 61-69.

capture.zh: 勇者之塔第62层：宾尼纳拉、巨镰鸟、艾丝柏，Lv240，每只约1200血。

strategy_notes.zh: 魔焰猩猩觉醒后打宾尼纳拉，镰鸟靠雷伊，最后丽莎

engine_notes: Remake progression (V53/V54): floors are climbed in order from the ten-floor starting points 1, 11, …, 61; a loss, retreat or cancelled load keeps the attempted floor, and the party may recover between floors. The 2010 tower allowed no healing between floors and sent a loser back to floor 1 (4399 2010-04-13: 如果挑战失败，要重新从一层开打); fleeing kept progress (只剩一只精灵时除非胜券在握，最好逃跑).
Lv/HP from 聚侠 (61F Lv230 Hp1150 … 65F Lv270 Hp1350, i.e. +10 Lv per floor and HP = 5×Lv per monster); 66-70 are extrapolated on the same step.
heal_full_below {pct:20, member}: 61层以上的草系1/5血以下的时候会回满Hp (聚侠). Applies only to the grass-type member(s) listed by index; the engine's heal_full_below needs a per-member form.
Identification: team[2] is 艾丝柏 (361, electric, the evolution of 艾米): 4399 2010-06-23 艾丝珀, T客邦 2011-01-19 艾絲柏（電系）, 4399 2010-06-18 艾米的进化; 聚侠's 艾斯帕 is the same monster.
Unnamed skill slots of the members added from the line-up sources follow the tower's existing convention: the three highest-level learnset attacks and the highest-level status move.
source_note: 4399 勇者之塔61-70层简单攻略 (2010-10-10) and 聚侠 61-70层攻略 (61-65 line-ups with Lv/HP).
